title: What's New: Service Management (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Service Quote Setup and Number Series

features.name: Service Quote Number Series Configuration
features.description: Service quote functionality with automatic number series assignment configured in setup window, preventing user modification of auto-generated numbers.

features.name: Service Item Blocking
features.description: New blocked field on service items allowing users to control whether items can be used in contracts or completely blocked from maintenance.
caveats: items can be blocked completely or from contracts only

features.name: Attachments in Service Documents
features.description: Attachments feature integrated across service quotes, orders, items and contracts, with ability to copy attachments from master data to service transactions.
caveats: attachments flow from master data through documents to posted transactions

features.name: Item Service Toggle at Variant Level
features.description: Ability to block individual item variants from service, sales and purchase operations at the variant level.

features.name: Select Items in Service Documents
features.description: Bulk item selection action in service documents similar to sales and purchase documents, allowing users to add multiple items at once.

features.name: Item References in Service
features.description: Item references including barcodes now available in service area documents for scanning support.
caveats: requires warehouse handheld device for scanning

features.name: Service Quote to Order Conversion
features.description: Ability to convert service quotes to service orders, carrying over attachments and service items.

features.name: Service Invoice Posting Policy
features.description: User-level setting controlling how service orders and invoices are processed, with options for shipment only, shipment with invoice, or separate processing.
caveats: posting options vary based on user setup configuration

features.name: Service Invoice and Credit Memo
features.description: Service invoice and credit memo documents now available with support for select items and attachments features.

features.name: Service Contract Template
features.description: Service contracts with predefined templates supporting bulk service item selection and automatic invoice generation.
caveats: blocked items cannot be added to contracts

features.name: Service Contract Invoice Deletion
features.description: Ability to delete service contract invoices with restrictions requiring deletion starting from the end due to ledger entry linkage.
caveats: invoices linked to service ledger entries must be deleted in order from end
some invoices for prepayment may not delete
